notes.title: Developer Demo Playthrough!
notes.notes:
Come take a look at our upcoming project, Alexandria IV, written by J.M. Beraldo, based on the Veil of Truth series.

Join Saulo as he plays through one of the many different paths available in the Alexandria IV Demo, and feel free to experience the Demo yourself ahead of the full release of the game, coming 2024!
